jobs.description: Director of Medical Laboratory Technology/Instructor or Assistant Professor of MLT Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Please see Special Instructions for more details. NOTE: If you are a veteran, disabled veteran, or spouse of a deceased veteran and would like Veteran’s Preference, we will need to see proof of status in order to grant that. Please see Veteran’s Preference section of the application for specific proof.Applicants for this position with ASU-Beebe must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with ASU-Beebe such as H1-B, F-1 (CPT/OPT), TN or any other status.U.S. Department of LaborKnow Your Rights https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights-ScreenRdr.pdfFamily and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf (English) https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlasp.pdf (Spanish)Employee Polygraph Protection Act https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppac.pdf Posting Details Position Information Position Type Faculty Job Title Director of Medical Laboratory Technology/Instructor or Assistant Professor of MLT Classification Title Twelve Month Faculty Campus Location ASU Beebe Job Description GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION Arkansas State University-Beebe, a comprehensive two-year community & technical college and part of the Arkansas State University System, is seeking a Director of the Medical Laboratory Technician Program. The College is focused on teaching and learning, and emphasizes student success at all levels and is interested in candidates who value those same attributes. Candidates must appreciate and understand the mission and purpose of an open-access, community and technical college. As a collaborative, energetic leader, the successful candidate will demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills; a strong commitment to student success; comfortable with change, innovation, and technology; and the use of data for decision-making.The Director will report directly to the Dean of Math and Science and have a voice in the MLT program decisions. The MLT Director is responsible for coordinating the delivery of instruction, for ensuring the quality of instruction, budget management, and for the overall leadership, organization, administration, supervision, and effectiveness of the program. The director is responsible for operating the MLT program in accordance with NAACLS Standards and maintaining program accreditation. The Director will oversee continuous quality improvement activities, supervise program faculty and staff, maintain regular communication with students, faculty, clinical affiliates, administration, and program personnel, and ensure the quality and effectiveness of both didactic and clinical education experiences. The Director is a faculty member who will teach the equivalent of 15 credit hours per semester.ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Oversee all aspects of the MLT program; maintain compliance with all NAACLS accreditation standards; coordinate accreditation activities, reports, and self-studies; and ensure the overall effectiveness of the program. Participate in the preparation, development, and management of the program budget, including identifying resources to meet program needs. Oversee the MLT course schedule in collaboration with the Director of Allied Health to promote student engagement, persistence, and retention. Periodically evaluate the course schedule, curriculum, student learning outcomes, program outcomes, and all aspects of the MLT program through a continuous quality improvement process. Use assessment data, graduate outcomes, employer feedback, advisory committee recommendations, certification examination performance, retention, placement, and graduation rates to improve program effectiveness and student success. Direct, supervise, mentor, and evaluate program faculty, adjunct faculty, laboratory personnel, and other program staff as applicable to ensure effective delivery of instruction and program operations. Maintain and seek new partnerships, programs, and grant funding for training opportunities. Develop contracts, memorandums of understanding (MOUs), and agreements between partners. Aid in the development of short and long term MLT development plans, as well as gathering of information and preparation of studies, reports, and recommendations to achieve goals. Maintain professional competence through continuing education, participation in professional organizations, conferences, workshops, and by maintaining required credentials and certification. Deliver effective instruction by assuming primary responsibility for curriculum planning, development, implementation, evaluation, assessment, and revision in accordance with NAACLS Standards and College policies. Teach assigned courses using effective instructional methodologies; provide academic advising; develop and assess student learning outcomes; and participate in professional development and institutional service. Coordinate, evaluate, and maintain all clinical education experiences; establish and maintain effective relationships with clinical affiliates; evaluate clinical sites and instructors; and ensure students receive appropriate supervision and educational experiences during clinical rotations. Promote a positive, collaborative work environment by demonstrating professionalism, sound judgment, effective interpersonal skills, teamwork, and exceptional customer service. Complete all required training and professional development sessions at ASUB and to keep ASCP-BOC or ASCPi-BOC generalist certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist. jobs.description: Group Exercise Instructor - Student Worker Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Please see Special Instructions for more details. If you have any of the following certifications, please attach them.- CPR/AED/First Aid Certification- Group Exercise Instructor Certification Posting Details Title Information Working Title Group Exercise Instructor - Student Worker Full-Time/Part-Time Part Time Student Worker $ Amount (Hourly or Assignment Rate) 13.00 Will this position be Onsite, Remote, or Hybrid? Onsite Position Details Position Information Posting Number S1352026 Department Name Campus Recreation and Wellness Funding Type UCA Student Help Position Summary The purpose of this position is to provide group exercise opportunities to the students, faculty, and staff of UCA. The instructor will provide a safe, well-organized, and accessible class for all fitness levels. The instructor will enforce all building policies pertaining to group exercises and appropriate use of the studios. The group exercise instructor will act as a representative of the Campus Recreation and Wellness department and must maintain professional composure and appearance while working with the facility. Job Duties and Responsibilities Position Responsibilities Provide patrons with safe, reasonable exercise class that can be performed by all fitness levels. Demonstrate proper forms of exercises/movements performed in the class. Demonstrate the ability to incorporate optimal usage of cuing, tempo, choreography, and safe transitional movements from one pattern to another. Instructors must demonstrate a high enough degree of energy and have the endurance to complete each fitness class. Attend all mandatory meetings and trainings. Arrive at class on time, which is 5-10 minutes before the scheduled start time. To set up and prepare for the class. Maintain the cleanliness and tidiness of the studio and equipment, ensuring patrons are using the equipment appropriately. Communicate with the Assistant Director of the Fitness Center about group exercise needs, cancellations of classes, and issues with equipment. Act in a professional manner by following T-Rec policies and upholding patrons to the standard while instructing classes. Position Requirements Current CPR/AED/First Aid certification (or received 1 month after hire date) Willingness to work hard and desire to learn. Effective communication skills. Highly punctual and can work independently. Ability to handle confrontation in a confident and professional manner. Master the knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) in the following areas: Group exercise class layout Appropriate movement modifications for varying fitness levels Group exercise class timing Mirroring University, Campus, and Community Description Thank you for your interest in employment at the University of Central Arkansas.Founded in 1907, UCA has an enrollment of more than 10,000 students and employs over 1,300 full-time employees. The university offers more than 85 undergraduate and 59 graduate certificate and degree programs, including doctoral programs in five disciplines. UCA is proud of its tradition of teaching excellence and its contributions in research, scholarship, and creative activities. jobs.description: Instructor of Welding Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Please see Special Instructions for more details. NOTE: If you are a veteran, disabled veteran, or spouse of a deceased veteran and would like Veteran’s Preference, we will need to see proof of status in order to grant that. Please see Veteran’s Preference section of the application for specific proof.Applicants for this position with ASU-Beebe must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with ASU-Beebe such as H1-B, F-1 (CPT/OPT), TN or any other status.U.S. Department of LaborKnow Your Rights https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights-ScreenRdr.pdfFamily and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf (English) https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlasp.pdf (Spanish)Employee Polygraph Protection Act https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppac.pdf Posting Details Position Information Position Type Faculty Job Title Instructor of Welding Classification Title Instructor Campus Location ASU Searcy Job Description GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION This position will begin the Fall semester of 2026 meeting at the ASU Beebe Searcy campus. Beginning in the Spring semester of 2027, this class will be taught at the Jacksonville High School campus in Jacksonville, Arkansas.The successful candidate will possess a thorough knowledge of the discipline required to share in the teaching of secondary students. The Welding instructor is responsible for teaching in the classroom and lab environment. Welding processes to be taught include, but are not limited to, GTAW (Gas Tungsten Arc Welding), GMAW (Gas Metal Arc Welding), FCAW (Fux Core Arc Welding), SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding), and Metal Fabrication, both in the basic and advanced processes. NCCER and AWS D1.1 curriculum will be used in the instruction. The instructor must be able to inspect welds to grant AWS certifications, under the direct supervision of a qualified AWS CWI, to the students according to the AWS D1.1 and ASME guidelines or be willing to obtain those certifications. It is preferred for the instructor to be able to also provide OSHA safety training. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Provide instruction in a classroom and a lab environment.2. Provide NCCER Training Certifications.3. Provide OSHA Training Certifications in accordance with D1.1 and ASME Codes.4. Maintain parts inventory and cleanliness in the Welding shop area.5. Cultivate relationships with the Welding advisory committee membership to achieve program and college goals. Maintain relevant industry curriculum with the establishment of program-level outcomes for the welding program with the guidance of the advisory committee members.6. Achieve program recruitment goals to ensure a minimum annual program enrollment of at least 25 students.7. Work closely with the Regional Career Center Director and Dean of Career Education to achieve recruitment and program goals.8. Assist with fundraising and grant writing for the Welding program.9. Ability to create lesson plans and program-level outcomes and carry them out effectively as well as follow written curriculum.10. Use college technology such as CANVAS, Campus Management, Office 365 adequately and appropriately.Performed any other related duties as required and assigned. Required Qualifications Associate’s degree. Three to Five years verifiable, work-related experience in structuralwelding or pipe welding field. Ability to successfully pass a structural welding knowledge testand a FCAW 3G with backing, a FCAW 4G with backing, a SMAW 3G with backing, a SMAW 4G with backing and a 6G Open V-Groove weld on Pipe with a 6010 root. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in related field. AWS CWI and CWE credentials. NCCER Instructorcertification. Previous teaching experience. Ability to successfully pass a structural weldingknowledge test and a FCAW 3G with backing, a FCAW 4G with backing, a SMAW 3G with backing, a SMAW 4G with backing and a 6G Open V-Groove weld on Pipe both with a 6010 SMAW root and GTAW root. Minimum Salary or Salary Range $46,694 Physical Activities Stand frequently Walk frequently Sit occasionally Use hands to finger, handle, or feel regularly Reach with hands and arms regularly Climb or balance occasionally Stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl frequently Talk or Hear continuously Taste or smell Physical Exertion Up to 10 pounds occasionally Up to 25 pounds occasionally Up to 50 pounds occasionally Up to 100 pounds More than 100 pounds Vision Requirements Does this position have any special vision requirements? Check all that apply. Close vision, Depth perception, Ability to adjust focus Posting Detail Information Background Check Statement This position will be subject to a pre-employment criminal, sex-offender registry background check. In cases where pre-determined, an additional financial/credit history/ background check may be required as well. Convictions that have been sealed or legally eradicated and misdemeanor convictions for which probation was completed and the case was dismissed, will be excluded. Disclosure does not constitute an automatic bar to employment. Factors such as dates of the offense, seriousness and nature of the violation, rehabilitation and position applied for will be taken into account. Medical Professions Instructor - Secondary Center
jobs.description: Loading…{"id": "1qsaJ96eAo9_eA6_pspvPpKsRfxtID7w5", "title": "Medical Professions Instructor - Secondary Center.pdf", "mimeType": "application\/pdf"}Page 1 of 3Medical Professions Instructor (Grant-Funded) Position: Position is 2⁄3 restricted (grant-funded) ten-month appointment beginning immediately. This contracted position follows an academic calendar that aligns with the area high schools. The successful candidate will teach Medical Professions, Patient Care Tech I and II, Foundations of Healthcare, and Introduction to Anatomy and Physiology courses to high school students enrolled in the ANC Secondary Technical Center. In addition to classroom instruction, the instructor is responsible for assessing and evaluating student learning outcomes, engaging in curriculum planning and review, and actively participate in student recruitment and retention-related activities. The position reports to the ANC Technical Center Director. Qualifications: Unencumbered license as a Registered Nurse in the State of Arkansas or Compact State of residence. An Associates Degree in Nursing is required. Have or be willing to obtain CPR and EMR Instructor credentials. The Instructor must possess a minimum of two (2) years nursing experience. The successful candidate must demonstrate knowledge of Medical Professions skills and competencies, and the ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, and the ability to utilize technology. Must be student- centered, results-oriented, enthusiastic, and able to work independently and as part of a team. Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills along with demonstrating excellent organizational skills. Must pass a federal, state, and local background check as well as pass Child Maltreatment Registry check. Responsibilities: ➢ Coordinates and conducts the development of a secondary program for Medical Professions including curriculum development and revision. ➢ Teaches the required number of classes to meet the student demand. ➢ Demonstrates appropriate lesson planning and preparation for classroom, lab, and clinical. ➢ Provides clinical instruction, supervision and evaluation for students in the clinical lab and clinical facilities as assigned and approved by any and all regulatory agencies. Page 2 of 3➢ Evaluates student progress in the classroom, clinical lab and clinical agencies as indicated and assigned. ➢ Maintains an annual evaluation portfolio of teaching and professional activities that demonstrates professional growth. ➢ Responsible for program/course(s) Assessment Process to include data collection, analysis and reporting utilizing results for course/program decision making and process improvement. ➢ Provides safe, effective and organized classroom/clinical labs, ordering supplies and keeping equipment appropriately maintained ➢ Maintains clinical competencies including CPR and develops/maintains skills in a variety of teaching/learning methodologies ➢ Develops and utilizes a multitude of engaging student activities that relate to the world of work, including off-site visits to relevant business/industries. ➢ Encourages and sponsors student involvement in extracurricular activities, including T.O.P.S. and SkillsUSA, and a summer MASH health sciences camp. ➢ Partners with ANC Career Coaches and Digital Learning Instructor to deliver workplace readiness curriculum, remediation, and maintains relationships with local school districts. ➢ Develops partnerships with local school systems and businesses to help recruit students into program and to develop and maintain on-the-job experiences and job placement opportunities. ➢ Maintains and enhances the College’s relationship with secondary school administrators, guidance counselors, and other educational institutions. ➢ Promotes programs and recruits students through public speaking engagements. ➢ Represents ANC at regional events, such as fairs, festivals, and other community events. Collects information needed from students to answer inquiries concerning academic offerings and assists with student activities, including new student orientation. ➢ Collects, compiles, analyzes, and documents participant records and maintains updates as directed, including attendance, grades, and discipline records. ➢ Actively educates students regarding career planning, secondary/postsecondary educational information, and assists students with the transition to college and career. ➢ Participates in professional development required by the College and in order to meet all certifications and licensure requirements of the Arkansas Department of Career Education. ➢ Participates in Technical Center efforts to build a positive learning environment for all students, including support of incentive programs and student engagement activities/events. Page 3 of 3➢ Plans and/or supervises special field trips, banquets, tutoring activities, and workshops. ➢ Attends staff meetings, in-service training, and out-of-town and local conferences, as required. ➢ Performs other related duties as required or assigned. Salary: Salary is determined by education and experience as defined on the Faculty Placement Schedule. A generous fringe benefits package is included. Application Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position Deadline: is filled. Interviews may occur throughout the application period. Application To apply, send completed ANC application, letter of interest, resume, Procedures: references, and transcripts/certifications to: Office of Human Resources, Arkansas Northeastern College, P.O. Box 1109, Blytheville, AR 72316- 1109 or email anc-hr@smail.anc.edu. For more information call (870) 762- 3121. To print an application, visit the college’s website (www.anc.edu/jobs). Applicants applying for a position requiring a license, certificate, and/or educational attainment beyond the high school level will be required to provide the official documents prior to being approved for hire.
